normal_operation_case_TC.note: the merged runs are rev 3 (perfect contact, the conductance upper bound kept by 236 (2)); no rev-4 merged run exists and none is started (no new thermal run without the lead). Rev 4 changes the seat heat paths; the rev-3 vs rev-4 GV station rows show its effect on the station.

notes: The surrogate's field shape is the nominal B1 end-of-burn shape; a real abort follows an off-nominal burn whose shape is not modelled (ASSUMED, sizing only).

Station offset: at the end of the nominal burn the case TC station reads 1.4-1.5 K below the TC-01 maximum, so a trip at a station reading A leaves the TC-01 maximum at about A + offset; the surrogate sets the TC-01 maximum to A, non-conservative by the offset; its effect on the TB70 seat cells (interpolated in A, [at A, at A + offset]) is in station_offset_sensitivity_TB70.

Open joints: GVLO / GVHI carry the joints as gap conductances (open-joint bounds); the T-F2 joint states at each TB state (floor closed over the S03 lands with um-level openings at the flange OD, thread radially open, top gap open) are consistent with an open thread gap and a closed flange land; the GVLO-GVHI spread at the same A (TC-02 about 15 K) is the joint-conductance sensitivity of the surrogate.

proposals: (1) CUT THE SOAK BENDING AT ITS SOURCE (sized, DERIVED on LCF v2): per firing at Kf 3.0 the soak screw moment must fall by 35.8 % (4096 N) / 30.6 % (3750 N) in every soak state and instance (largest case SOAK|4096|js5|Kf3.0: M 5338.8 -> 3429.6 N mm); 1 % at Kf 2.2 and 55.9 % at Kf 3.8. The from-zero row cannot be closed by bending alone at Kf 3.0 (3 cases have an axial part above the MS-0 value, 634.2 vs 575 MPa at SOAK52|4096|(b2) rep|Kf3.0); at Kf 2.2 it needs 78.3 %. The bending is the seat tilt of the TC-01 ring under the shell pull (FE envelope v3, M at x'28.6 at SOAK70 1088.7-3111.7 N mm over the instances, (b2) highest; SOAK 188.3-3481, js5 highest; the IN718 rows carry the threaded-section maximum x the E ratio x the seat contact-force ratio, rows v6 (7)): the seat footprint (edge break, spot-face bearing ring) and the shell pull (the select-fit gap; P+Q band g <= 0.068 mm on relax v7) are the levers; each needs an FE instance before it can be credited.

(2) THREAD-ROOT Kf: specify the ENG-HW-101-IN718 thread rolled after ageing with a controlled root radius (an MJ-form external thread, ISO 5855-2, mates with the M5-6H tapped TC-02): at Kf 2.2 the per-firing row needs 0 % less bending at 3750 N and 1 % at 4096 N (from zero still 73 / 78.3 %); the Kf of such a root on IN718 is TO-SOURCE (no as-recalled value); the MJ / M mating (thread class, root clearance) is TO-CHECK against ISO 5855-2 before any ruling.

(3) LOWER J-F1 MAXIMUM PRELOAD: the from-zero fibre falls with the preload (axial part and the tilt contact force); the per-firing range falls only through the bending term (dF_S/dF_V = 1.000 at the soak); bounded below by the 2250 N minimum. The 239 (3) every-head-seated requirement already fails at BOTH install ends on the envelope (relax v7, seat family: k_b lo: 6 of 12 at 2250 N, 3 of 12 at 4096 N, F_S min -239 N; k_b hi: 6 of 12 at 2250 N, 6 of 12 at 4096 N, F_S min -323 N), so a lower maximum does not change the slack verdict.

(4) LONGER GRIP (lower curvature for the same imposed end rotation, M ~ 1 / L for a rotation-driven moment): a 35.8 % cut needs 1.56 x the grip, i.e. about +1.8 mm on the model grip L_G 3.15 mm, against the 0.5 mm under-head FD-04 budget: does not fit; not proposed.

(5) A DISC SPRING (route (i)) does NOT reduce the soak fibre: spring v3 shows it solid at every hot frame (T01 >= 140 C), so the hot fibre and the per-firing range of the seated cases are unchanged; it only removes the slack end of the slack cases.

recommendation.text: Mechanical recommends A = 150 C (423.15 K) on the case TC station: the highest trial value that (1) passes 183 (1) (a)-(c) and no leak on both bounds for TB70 (1.5 / 2.0) and TBS (1.0 / 1.5) under the seat-matrix rule and under min(C5, C3n, C4n); (2) stays above every normal-operation armed-phase station maximum, by +12.3 K over the rev-3 merged perfect-contact B1 burn (137.74 C), +32.9 K over B1 rev 4 GVHI and +41.8 K over GVLO; (3) limits TC-02's time above 150 C after the trip to 35.6 | 29.7 s (GVLO | GVHI; ASSUMED shifted history: the TC-02 soak plateau stays below 150 C), against 640-1192 s at 165-175 C; (4) holds the TC-01 maximum at the trip at its 150 C usable limit, within the station offset (the TC-01 maximum runs 1.4-1.5 K above the station on the GV bounds and 2.6 K on the merged run). (d) stays OPEN at every A and in nominal operation (T-F1 gate); at this A the T-F1 coupon temperature is the TB part maximum TC-02 223.4 | 208 C (GVLO | GVHI) and the TC-01 shifted-soak maximum 232.1 | 218.4 C. The 175 C (448.15 K) value of line 188 (5) cannot be shown against a sourced short-time allowable (T-F1 not obtained) and leaves TC-01 above its usable limit at the trip and TC-02 above 150 C for about 20 min after it (ASSUMED). Electronics confirms that its channel tolerance fits inside the 12.3 K margin to the merged armed maximum; if it does not, the next lower trial value (135 C) is BELOW the merged armed maximum and would trip a nominal burn in the perfect-contact bound.
notes: (a) on the frictional variants: the mechanical increment S2 - S1 at the TC-02 entry-tangent contact edge includes the change of the frictional contact state between the thermal-only and the total step (path-dependent); the C3n / C4n (a) cells are non-monotonic in A and all positive; C5 (frictionless) gives the larger values; shown as found.

TC-02 / TC-03 regular cells at the entry-tangent contact edge: at the TB reference (TBS TB) the C5 / C3n / C4n regular value does not pass the 5 % refinement test (demand +8-9 % per halving, decreasing); the cells take the regular value by the 234 (4) thread-tie rule (the all-node minimum sits at the smeared-thread tie end, replaced by the J-TC03 CALC), are quoted at h 0.1 with the h 0.05 estimate beside them, and the verdicts hold at the estimate (verdict_abc_at_h0p05_estimate).
Combined MS at the case SF is negative for TC-02 / TC-03 at TB70 for the higher A (TS-183 candidates): accepted only with (a)-(c) passing and (d), which is OPEN (T-F1).
No new thermal run was made; no CAD change is proposed by this package.
